resource_policy.note: Each required definition is queued and serialized once per preparation. No second dense SVG tree in the live view. Native rasterization/encoding and retained-image limits unchanged; process RSS not measured.

native_editor_journey.coverage: Native mouse/keyboard zoom, 20-key bursts coalescing to one vector request, cached divider drags, distant-page navigation and backend switching; dense partial and standard full fixtures.
native_editor_journey.not_established: Physical trackpad pinch, GPU presentation cadence or a matched whole-editor end-to-end performance improvement.

native_editor_initial_failure.reason: The journey sent End after a root divider drag without returning keyboard input to the preview. The recorded preview_keyboard_focused was false, native render ready and all prior partial/full zoom and divider checks passed.
native_editor_initial_failure.correction: Click the preview and require preview_keyboard_focused before the viewer-only key; rerun the same optimized executable.

initial_broad_test_failure.classification: Existing fake-tool fixture startup timeouts at default test concurrency.
initial_broad_test_failure.resolution: 34 Tinymist tests passed serially; the complete default and profiling suites passed with RUST_TEST_THREADS=4. No fixture timeout assertions changed or tests excluded.

validation.browser_scope: Fresh Chromium raster of serialized buffer inspected; glyphs and offset preserved. Full/partial live palette/raster and dependency integration tests passed. This is not composed-editor pixel evidence.

limitations: macOS14.6.1 arm64, low-power mode, 900x700 CSS pixels and 2x backing scale; same fixed inputs and optimized native binary within each pair.
9 measured preparations after one warmup; no builds or other profiling workloads during measured runs.
Partial uses dense 48-page unequal fractional papers. Full uses standard48-page fixture because full dense stress exceeds its existing resource budget.
Canonical output equality is tested at the same frame with definitions sorted; source/scroll/palette remain unchanged.
No claim of faster final Typst SVG rendering, presented GPU frames, physical pinch, cross-platform speed or whole-editor end-to-end improvement.
